_about: Theme tokens for Antigravity generative-UI exports. Antigravity supplies these CSS variables from the app theme at view time and strips them on Export Artifact (documented in Google's /generative_ui docs). SAMPLED 2026-11-07 from the user's in-app screenshots of the ArgonThreadRnD deck (dominant flat fills): --background #191414, --card #282424, --primary #cc4100, --foreground #ffffff, --primary-foreground #ffffff, --muted-foreground #a8a9b2, --border #383434, --secondary #332f2f. DERIVED (set equal to a sampled relative, same role): --card-foreground, --popover, --popover-foreground, --muted, --accent, --accent-foreground, --destructive-foreground, --input, --ring, --chart-1, and --secondary-foreground (= --foreground). CONVENTIONAL (the token family's published dark-theme defaults, not sampled; no red exists in the source palette): --destructive #7f1d1d, --radius 0.5rem. NOT included: --chart-2..5 (no grounded values) — an export referencing them makes the fixer stop and name them, by design. Edit freely; the fixer reports any referenced variable this file does not define.
